notes: The clause 'ṅatabhucchayātor ādharadhana ‥‥ siṃyātacosyaṃ viyājuhā' indicates the copy was written and given to someone ending in -siṃha (‥‥ siṃyāta). The role of 'ādharadhana' is unclear due to the lacuna: it may be a personal name (perhaps a father whose son received the manuscript, or an agent/scribe), hence assigned role 'other' with low confidence. 'ṅatabhucchayātor' refers to a neighborhood (tol) in the Ṅata (Nardevi) quarter of Kathmandu.
